crossExchangeObservations.summary: LCC Projects Limited has informed the Exchange about receipt of Acceptance of Tender (AOT) from the office of Executive Engineer, Sauni Yojana Division, Government of Gujarat in respect of the work  Engineering, Procurement and Construction (EPC) Contract   Supply Water from Machhu-I Dam to Triveni Thanga Reservoir and various villages of Wankaner and Chotila Taluka, with Operation and Maintenance of the commissioned project for 10 years having estimated value of INR.151.57 crore (excluding GST)
